proof_body:
by
  intro f x r d hc hr hd hd0 hx
  have tangent : f x + d * (r - x) ≤ f r := by
    rcases lt_trichotomy r x with hlt | heq | hgt
    · have h := hc.slope_le_of_hasDerivAt (Set.mem_univ r) (Set.mem_univ x) hlt hd
      rw [slope_def_field, div_le_iff₀ (sub_pos.2 hlt)] at h
      nlinarith
    · subst heq
      simp
    · have h := hc.le_slope_of_hasDerivAt (Set.mem_univ x) (Set.mem_univ r) hgt hd
      rw [slope_def_field, le_div_iff₀ (sub_pos.2 hgt)] at h
      nlinarith
  constructor
  · have h : f x / d ≤ x - r := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hd0]
      nlinarith
    linarith
  · have h : 0 ≤ f x / d := div_nonneg hx hd0.le
    linarith
target_source: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x r d : ℝ), ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ f → f r = 0 → HasDerivAt f d x → 0 < d → 0 ≤ f x → r ≤ x - f x / d ∧ x - f x / d ≤ x
